$comment: Human-curated source for the Kazimierz tour (course krakow-kazimierz, docs/research/new-tours.md §2). Same format as royal-route.json: tour-level id, personaId, titles, summaries, fixedStartPoiId, fixedEndPoiId, estMinutes and per-stop poiId, dwellS, prize, triggerRadiusM, approachRadiusM mirror contracts/Model.ets Tour/TourStop; per-stop wikidataId, kind, names, lat, lng and view {look, feature} feed the Poi records. Review-only keys (not emitted): $comment, courseId, mapArea, sourceQids, summariesReview, namesSource, estMinutesBasis, coordinatesConfirmedBy, coordinateMethod, radiiNote, toneNote, n, sensitive, coordinateSource, coordinateCheck, view.basis, view.review. view.feature pl/zh are the translated view hints of the review files (translate-v1). Coordinates, radii, dwell times, prizes and view hints are agent drafts until a human confirms them.

summaries.en: King Casimir's royal town of Kazimierz, where Catholic Kraków and one of Poland's oldest Jewish quarters lived side by side for five centuries: from the church on the Rock past the old town hall and Plac Nowy to the synagogues around Szeroka Street. The synagogues and the old cemetery are places of worship and remembrance. 11 stops, about 2 km on foot.
summaries.pl: Królewskie miasto Kazimierza Wielkiego, w którym katolicki Kraków i jedna z najstarszych dzielnic żydowskich w Polsce przez pięć wieków żyły obok siebie: od kościoła na Skałce przez dawny ratusz i plac Nowy do synagog wokół ulicy Szerokiej. Synagogi i stary cmentarz to miejsca modlitwy i pamięci. 11 przystanków, około 2 km pieszo.
summaries.zh: 卡齐米日大帝建立的王家城镇：五个世纪里，天主教的克拉科夫与波兰最古老的犹太街区之一在这里比邻而居。从岩石上的教堂出发，经过旧市政厅和新广场，直到宽街周围的犹太会堂。犹太会堂和老墓地是祈祷与纪念之地。共11站，步行约2公里。

summariesReview: en drafted by the agent; pl and zh are agent drafts not yet checked by a native speaker
namesSource: Short display names curated for the app. zh follows the Wikidata labels converted to simplified script (庫帕猶太會堂 -> 库帕犹太会堂, 萊姆猶太會堂 -> 莱姆犹太会堂, 沃爾夫·波佩猶太會堂 -> 沃尔夫·波佩犹太会堂, 舊猶太會堂 -> 旧犹太会堂); stops 2, 3 and 5 have no zh label: 圣加大利纳教堂, 卡齐米日市政厅, 新广场 are drafts (docs/research/new-tours.md §2) to be checked by a native speaker.
estMinutesBasis: OSRM foot, listed order, stop to stop: 2,151 m / 28.8 min (data/raw/tours/kazimierz/osrm/stop-pairs-foot.json) + dwell 1680 s (28 min) = 56.8 min, rounded up to 57. The listed order is the exact optimum for the fixed start and end (docs/research/new-tours.md §2).
coordinateMethod: lat/lng = Wikidata P625. Each stop is cross-checked against the centroid of the OSM element tagged with the same wikidata= in the krakow-kazimierz map tiles (data/raw/osm/oldtown-tile{1..3} + kazimierz-tile{1..5}); osrmSnapM = distance OSRM moved the point to the nearest walkable way (data/raw/tours/kazimierz/osrm/stops-table-foot.json). flag = OSM element more than 40 m away.
radiiNote: Draft values for review. Default 35 m; 40-45 m where OSRM snaps more than 25 m or the building is large; Plac Nowy 50 m (square). Every radius exceeds the stop's OSRM snap distance. The synagogues on Szeroka are 108-140 m apart, so the circles do not overlap; approachRadiusM 110 (ARCHITECTURE default).
toneNote: Stops 6-11 (the synagogues) cover the Holocaust and the post-war Kraków pogrom. Scripts are factual and respectful: no jokes, no exclamation marks, no trivia framing, no prize language in narration (docs/research/new-tours.md §2.2; enforced by the tone rule of scripts/pack/review/check-drafts.mjs for this course). prize is for planning only.
